skill.title: Python Programming

about.title: About This Skill
paragraphs: Python is one of the most versatile and beginner-friendly programming languages. In this peer-to-peer learning exchange, you'll learn Python from the ground up — covering fundamentals like variables, loops, and functions, then moving into real-world applications like data analysis and web scripting.

Whether you're a complete beginner or looking to strengthen your programming foundation, this skill exchange is designed to be practical and hands-on. You'll work on small projects and exercises that build your confidence step by step.

whatYoullLearn: Python syntax, variables, data types, and operators
Control flow — if/else statements, loops, and logic
Working with lists, dictionaries, and file handling
Introduction to libraries like NumPy and Pandas
Building a small project from scratch
